title: Simply Throwables
description: This mod allow you to throw ALMOST anything, blocks and item, you name it!
body:
everything that you see, you can throw!

Command:

/throwable on	Enables throwing globally.

/throwable off	Disables throwing globally and restores vanilla item use.

The setting applies immediately to all connected players and resets to enabled after a server restart.
